reason: Recharging the cold packs addresses the transfer reserve and seems like a natural use of the powered freezer.
expectation: I expect the freezer to recharge the cold packs and complete that goal.

alternatives.reason: Restarting propellant production also serves a goal, but I chose to restore the cold reserve first.

effect: The cold-transfer reserve is recharged, leaving propellant production to restart.
reaction: The result was expected and reassuring.
reason: Restarting the plant addresses the remaining goal and is the only combination offered.
expectation: I expect the restored solar supply to restart propellant production, though the tanks may still take time to refill.

effect: The return plant is running again, completing the remaining goal; the result does not say the tanks are full.
reaction: The restart was expected and reassuring, though it added little detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Recharging the cold packs was most worthwhile because it restored the transfer reserve for the frozen core.

leastWorthwhile.text: Restarting the plant was straightforward, but the result gave little insight into how production resumes.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; both actions had the expected results.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: each directly matched a stated goal and an available hotspot.

continue.text: I would continue to find out how the frozen body reaches Earth and what can be learned from it, although this short chapter offered few decisions.
